author: Mark Atwood
text: Reparented under JMAP-prpm (jmap-base-client 0.2.0 coordinated minor bump umbrella). The dep on JMAP-6r7c.48 already links this to the typed-Sha256 reshape; reparenting makes the umbrella-grouping explicit. This follow-up cleanup (delete is_valid_sha256_hex helper, remove to_ascii_lowercase normalize step, drop InvalidArgument('expected_sha256 is not 64-char hex') branch) lands in the same 0.2.0 release as .48.
